faq.q: Is this page a Surrey listings page?
faq.a: No: at reading it carried no MLS® listings, no result count and no market figures — it is an index of 36 City of Surrey secondary-plan tiles (NCPs, GLUPs, LAPs, town centre and corridor plans) linking onward to the City's plan material and to the site's Surrey search pages.

faq.q: What is the difference between a GLUP, an NCP and an LAP in Surrey?
faq.a: On the City's own organization: a General Land Use Plan sets the overall framework for an area, a Neighbourhood Concept Plan provides the detailed neighbourhood plan under it, and a Local Area Plan does the same guiding work for areas planned outside the NCP process; approved plans are developed through community consultation and endorsed by Council, and they guide designations, density, roads, amenities and servicing.

faq.q: Is "Surrey City Centre" a real estate board sub-area?
faq.a: No — on this program's settled position, Surrey City Centre is NOT a board name; the land is the Whalley sub-area. "City Centre" is the City of Surrey's planning name for its downtown, which is why the City Centre Plan tile legitimately uses it.
